page.overview:
What is Harbor?

Harbors are used as fast-travel points in . They are scattered about the regions and are functionally identical to a Signpost, though they can only be utilized if the player is sailing in a boat (i.e. if the player is just standing in a boat, harbors won't appear on the map).
